llm.summary: The skill is mostly normal Go safety guidance, but it asks for broader repository and agent powers than its purpose clearly needs.

dimensions.detail: Read/Edit/Write and Go lint/test commands fit a coding skill, but unrestricted Git subcommands and general agent delegation are broader than the documented Go safety review and editing purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The metadata declares an empty install list, and the inspected artifact files are Markdown/JSON guidance and eval data with no executable installer or bundled script.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The declared tools include unrestricted `Bash(git:*)` and `Agent` even though the runtime instructions do not define a bounded workflow for mutating Git operations or delegation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No artifact instructs persistence, credential access, exfiltration, or destructive actions, but the broad Git permission could enable repository configuration or hook changes if a host allowed those commands.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's content is coherent defensive Go coding guidance about nil safety, slice/map aliasing, numeric checks, defer usage, and related bug prevention.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable granting this skill broad repository-level Git command access and agent delegation. Prefer a version that narrows Git to read-only inspection commands or clearly documents when mutating Git operations and delegation may occur.
llm.findings:
[EA2] expected: The cited eval entries are test cases about Go nil-pointer guards; the phrase `without checking` describes a programming trap, not autonomous high-impact action by the skill.
[T05] unexpected: The broad `Bash(git:*)` and `Agent` allowance is real artifact evidence and is not well scoped by the skill instructions, so it supports Review rather than a benign pass.
